clue.text: It gives prior knowledge of day two of tourist's holiday

definitions.text: It gives prior knowledge of day two of tourist's holiday

parts.words: It gives prior knowledge of day two of tourist's holiday
parts.note: the gift of foreseeing the future, read jokingly as the next day of a sightseeing trip: the second day's touring

explanation.surface: A guidebook or forecast that tells you in advance what happens on the second day of a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Clairvoyance, the supposed power to perceive future events, gives foreknowledge; the pun splits it as the second round of seeing the sights.

clue.text: Liberal gets out of dull broadcast

indicators.note: the Liberal is said to leave the word for dull, so that letter is removed

parts.note: slow means dull, as of a slow-witted pupil or a sluggish day

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician walks out of a boring radio or TV programme.
explanation.definitionFit: To scatter seed widely by hand is the original sense of broadcast, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Spiteful, applying whip to rears of colt and pony

parts.note: a cat (cat-o'-nine-tails) is a whip

indicators.note: the rears of the two named animals are their final letters

explanation.surface: Someone cruelly taking a whip to the hindquarters of a young horse and a pony.
explanation.definitionFit: Catty describes malicious, sly remarks, a synonym for spiteful.

clue.text: Trashy souvenir 'one dropped, being twitchy

indicators.note: trashy suggests something cheap and wrecked, so the remaining letters are jumbled
the letter for one is dropped from the word souvenir before rearranging

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A tacky holiday souvenir is dropped, and its owner gets jumpy.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing I ('dropped') from SOUVENIR leaves SOUVENR, which 'Trashy' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Nervous and twitchy both describe someone anxious and jittery; the clue's 'being twitchy' stands for the adjective in a phrase like 'feeling twitchy'.

clue.text: Show worker getting measure of horse attached to coach

indicators.note: the second piece is joined on to the end of the first

parts.note: a stage, short for stagecoach, is a coach
a hand, four inches, is the unit for a horse's height

explanation.surface: A worker earns a living measuring horses hitched to a carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A stagehand works behind the scenes moving scenery in a theatre show.

clue.text: Old red adheres, though Labour leader's shifted

indicators.note: the moved letter is lifted out and placed elsewhere in the word

parts.note: glues means sticks, adheres

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Red politics still sticks, even though the Labour Party leader has been replaced.
explanation.walkthrough: The L of 'Labour leader' moves one place in GLUES to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Gules is the heraldic term for the colour red, an old Norman-French word.

clue.text: Forceful narrative

definitions.meaning: a ... argument is striking and effective
a ... of a story is a narration of it

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both striking in effect and the act of recounting a tale.

clue.text: Take care of parking.

parts.note: c/o, CO, is the abbreviation for care of in addresses
P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs

explanation.surface: Someone is told to look after the car parking.
explanation.definitionFit: To cop something is slang for to catch or take it, as in cop hold of this.

clue.text: Caught me in Arkansas' turning pale, not wanting to be shot?

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: the word for me sits inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: AR is the postal abbreviation for Arkansas
taken as written
ashy means ashen, pale

explanation.surface: An arrested man in Arkansas goes white, frightened of being shot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' is a link meaning becoming. 'Shot' misleads toward gunfire; here it means photographed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone reluctant to be photographed avoids the lens; shot here is a photo, not a bullet.

clue.text: It gives a point to many a painting

definitions.text: It gives a point to many a painting

parts.words: It gives a point to many a painting
parts.note: the technique that makes parallel lines meet at a vanishing point, giving pictures depth

explanation.definitionFit: Linear depth drawing makes receding lines converge at a vanishing point, which is the 'point' the clue means.

clue.text: It may be just a drop in the ocean, eventually

definitions.text: It may be just a drop in the ocean, eventually

parts.words: It may be just a drop in the ocean, eventually
parts.note: a cascade where a river plunges over a cliff; its stream ends up in the sea, and it is literally a drop

explanation.definitionFit: A cascade is a sheer drop of river flow, whose stream eventually reaches the sea.

clue.text: "A bird in both hands is worth a creature in tree"

indicators.note: the bird is placed inside the letters for the two hands

parts.note: L and R stand for left and right, the two hands
an emu is a bird

explanation.surface: A twist on the proverb: a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
explanation.definitionFit: A Madagascan primate living in the trees is an arboreal creature.

clue.text: Chap about to accept work — is it rigged?

parts.note: a guy is a chap, a man

indicators.note: the word for about takes in the work abbreviation

parts.note: re means about, concerning
op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: A man returns to take a job, suspecting a fix.
explanation.definitionFit: A tent line is part of the rigging that holds the canvas taut; rigged puns on fixed and fitted with ropes.

clue.text: Does he show some bottle when he's puffed out?

definitions.text: Does he show some bottle when he's puffed out?

parts.words: Does he show some bottle when he's puffed out?
parts.note: bottle means courage in slang, but here a glass bottle displayed by a craftsman who shapes molten glass with his breath

explanation.definitionFit: A craftsman who shapes molten glass by breathing through a tube produces bottles and runs out of breath.

clue.text: It may ease mounting troubles

parts.note: mounting is getting on a horse; a foot support helps the rider, and 'troubles' hints at the sound of stir up

explanation.definitionFit: A rider's foot loop hung from the saddle makes climbing onto a horse easier.

clue.text: Chilean describes where they're found?

indicators.note: the answer is found within the run of clue letters, as Chileans are found in the mountains

explanation.surface: A person from Chile explains where his countrymen are located.
explanation.definitionFit: The mountain range running down Chile is where many Chileans live.

clue.text: Very pessimistic believer conceals great achievement

indicators.note: the believer word hides the achievement word within it

parts.note: a deist is a believer in God
a feat is a great achievement

explanation.surface: A gloomy man of faith hides his own triumph.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone expecting to lose and giving up beforehand is extremely gloomy about outcomes.

clue.text: Medicine, primarily, lemon-flavoured, easing a cold, possibly

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: possibly means the letters might be arranged another way
primarily means first, so only the opening letter of the next word is used

parts.note: taken as written
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: A lemony remedy that may relieve a cold.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram pool is L (from 'primarily'), EASING, A and C, mixed by 'possibly'.
explanation.definitionFit: A painkiller is a type of medicine.

clue.text: Joseph, Isaac, Samuel etc categorically united over time share

indicators.note: in a down entry, the preceding pieces sit over the last one

parts.note: all means everyone together, the whole category
these are Old Testament men: OT for Old Testament plus MEN

explanation.surface: Biblical patriarchs united in a time-share.
explanation.definitionFit: An allotment is a portion or share allocated to someone.

clue.text: What's activated felt pads, muffling last of echo?

definitions.text: What's activated felt pads, muffling last of echo?

indicators.note: the rearranged letters wrap around the echo's last letter
activated means set in motion, stirring the letters into a new order
the last of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A piano pedal presses felt pads that deaden the echo.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of FELT PADS ('activated') wraps round O, the last of echo ('muffling').
explanation.definitionFit: The left piano pedal softens the tone, and figuratively means to play down.

clue.text: Father's almost completely sore

parts.note: pa is father

indicators.note: almost means a final letter is lost

parts.note: in full means completely

explanation.surface: A dad nearly entirely aching.
explanation.definitionFit: Painful and sore both describe a part of the body that hurts.

clue.text: I will follow most 'of fashion points

indicators.note: the I comes after the other piece
most of a word is all but its last letter

parts.note: style means fashion

explanation.surface: Someone vows to follow most fashions.
explanation.definitionFit: Styluses are pointed instruments such as gramophone needles.

clue.text: Food item? It needs standard treatment

parts.note: it is slang for sex appeal, abbreviated SA
usage is the customary way of treating something

explanation.surface: A food product requiring routine handling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It' as sex appeal (SA) is a crossword convention; 'needs' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A banger, meat in a skin, is an item of food; the question mark flags the loose class.

clue.text: Inclination to show, education, without one of its basics?

indicators.note: without means lacking, so a letter is removed

parts.note: learning is education
the three Rs, reading, writing and arithmetic, are the basics of education; R is one

explanation.surface: Schooling that lacks fundamentals, shown to lean one way.
explanation.definitionFit: A tendency or preference is a leaning, a synonym for inclination.

clue.text: Announcement of dinner arresting one's departure

indicators.note: arresting means catching and holding, so one letter is held inside

parts.note: a gong is sounded to announce dinner
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A dinner bell stops someone leaving.
explanation.definitionFit: Going means leaving, a departure.

clue.text: Delicacy and tact's first — minor disruption later

indicators.note: the next piece follows on
the first of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: a ruffle is a slight disturbance

explanation.surface: Tact comes first, but small upsets follow.
explanation.definitionFit: The prized edible fungus or chocolate sweet is a delicacy.

clue.text: Celebrated straight man stealing end of act

indicators.note: the straight man takes in the end of the act

parts.note: a feed is a comedian's straight man, who sets up the jokes

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A comedian's stooge steals the climax of the show.
explanation.definitionFit: To be feted is to be honoured and celebrated.

clue.text: Fanciful idea curtailed — leaves following suspicion

indicators.note: the second piece follows the first
curtailed means having its tail, the last letter, cut off

parts.note: a whim is a fanciful idea
ff is the abbreviation for following pages, or folios, leaves

explanation.surface: Someone drops a fancy idea and departs under suspicion.
explanation.definitionFit: A whiff is a faint hint or trace, a suspicion.

clue.text: Is a client perverse or intransigent?

indicators.note: perverse means contrary, twisted, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A customer is obstinate and difficult.
explanation.definitionFit: Unyielding and unbending, inelastic means unable to give, like intransigent.

clue.text: Cut final piece, serving fish

indicators.note: cut means a last letter is chopped off

parts.note: a coda is the final section of a piece of music

explanation.surface: A slice of fish served as the last course.
explanation.definitionFit: The cod is a well-known food fish.

clue.text: Incomplete memory? Nonsense

indicators.note: incomplete means missing its last letter

parts.note: rote is learning by memory

explanation.surface: Patchy recollection means rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Rot is rubbish talk, nonsense.

clue.text: White-haired and unsteady?

definitions.meaning: having a pale, fair-coloured head of hair

explanation.definitionFit: The word means giddy, and is read literally as having a pale crown of hair.
